limitation: Complete animation metadata and the 391-file binary acquisition batch are recorded. The batch contains 337 public-client VFX files and 54 troop sprite files stored under evidence/assets-v3/source-client; acquired-assets-v3.json records each path, byte count and SHA-256. Four representative matrix/title/VFX files are additionally copied to evidence/assets-v3 root for quick inspection. Public availability does not establish ownership or redistribution rights, and these assets are not part of the Dacky build manifest.
